subject: maths
question: Vinay and Mahesh are 250 metres apart from each other. They are moving towards each other with the speed of 36 km/hr and 54 km hr respectively. In how much time will they meet each other ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = Sum of Speeds = 36 + 54 = 90 km/hr.

Convert Speed to m/s = 90 × (5/18) = 25 m/s.

Meeting Time = Total Distance ÷ Relative Speed = 250 ÷ 25 = 10 seconds.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance between Vinay and Mahesh = 250 m

Speed of Vinay (S₁) = 36 km/hr

Speed of Mahesh (S₂) = 54 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Relative Speed (Opposite Direction) = S₁ + S₂

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3870e8c6f0ff44a42f1db3e3c0766b060118e0041fb6092ac73dc3ba21709682.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Speed in km/hr = 36 + 54 = 90 km/hr

⇒ Conversion to m/s: Speed × (5/18)

⇒ Relative Speed (Sᵣₑₗ) = 90 × (5/18) = 5 × 5 = 25 m/s

⇒ Time (T) = Distance (D) ÷ Sᵣₑₗ

⇒ T = 250 ÷ 25

⇒ T = 10 seconds

**∴ The correct answer is 10 seconds.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Cases

When moving in opposite directions, relative speed = S₁ + S₂. When moving in the same direction, relative speed = S₁ − S₂ (where S₁ > S₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply by 5/18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Meeting Time Formula

Time = Distance ÷ Relative Speed. This is applicable whether objects move towards each other or one chases another.</p
